sections.h: 4. Iifoto, Amazwi kunye Nomxholo Oveliswe yi-AI
sections.b:
4.1. Iifoto kunye neerekhodi zezwi ozilayishayo ziqhutywa kuphela emva kwesenzo sakho esicacileyo kwaye kuphela ukunika isiphumo esithile osicelayo (umzekelo, i-avatar yefoto okanye i-AI voiceover). Azisetyenziswa ukuchonga ubomi okanye ukuhlela ubomi bomntu, kwaye azisetyenziswa nguMboneleli ukuqeqesha iimodeli zobukrelekrele bokwenziwa.

4.2. Apho ukudala i-avatar okanye ikopi yezwi kufuna ukubhalisa izinto kunye nomboneleli we-AI womntu wesithathu (umzekelo iHeyGen okanye iElevenLabs), izinto zidluliselwa kuloo mboneleli ngokungqongqo kumsebenzi oceliweyo kwaye ziqhutywa phantsi kwemigaqo yaloo mboneleli kunye nezivumelwano zokuqhuba idatha.

4.3. Ungacima imidiya elayishiweyo kunye nezinto ezivelisiweyo kwigalari yeQonga nangaliphi na ixesha. Emva kokucinywa kweakhawunti yakho, umxholo ohambelana nawo uyasuswa, ngaphandle kokuba ukugcinwa kufunwa ngumthetho (bona iCandelo lesi-7).

4.4. Kufuneka ubambe amalungelo afanelekileyo kunye neemvume zomntu onomfanekiso okanye ilizwi lakhe olilayishayo okanye olikopisayo. Izibophelelo ezineenkcukacha zibekwe kwi Imigaqo yeNkonzo.

Ukuze kuqhutywe iQonga, uMboneleli usebenzisa iinkonzo zamaqela esithathu athembekileyo anokufumana ukufikelela okuyinxalenye kwidatha phantsi kwezivumelwano ezingqongqo, kwaye kuphela kwinqanaba elifunekayo:

  • Iziseko zophuhliso kunye nokusingathwa: Hostinger (iiseva ezibonakalayo ezikwiNgingqi yezoQoqosho yaseYurophu; iindawo zokugcina idatha kunye nekhowudi yesicelo).
  • Iintlawulo: Stripe (iintlawulo zobhaliso, ukufaka i-invoyisi, ukuthintela ubuqhetseba).
  • Ubuntlola bokwenziwa: Google (iimodeli zeGemini), Anthropic (iimodeli zeClaude), OpenAI, FAL.ai, HeyGen (ukubonisa i-avatar), ElevenLabs (ukudibanisa intetho kunye nokukopisha ilizwi) — nge-API yabo esemthethweni. Kuphela umxholo ofunekayo kumsebenzi othile owubizayo ogqithiselwayo.
  • Idatha yemidiya yoluntu: TikHub (ukufumana umxholo weqonga ofumaneka esidlangalaleni kunye nemetric).
  • Ukupapasha: Blotato kunye neenethiwekhi zentlalo ozidibanisayo (TikTok, Meta/Instagram, YouTube/Google) — zifumana umxholo owucwangciselayo ukupapashwa kunye neziqinisekiso ozidibanise kwiiakhawunti zakho.
  • Ukuqinisekiswa: Google (ukhetho lwe-"Ngena ngeGoogle").

Apho udibanisa esakho isitshixo se-API okanye ubhaliso lwenkonzo yomntu wesithathu, loo nkonzo icubungula idatha yakho phantsi kwesivumelwano sakho nayo; uMboneleli ugqithisela kuphela izicelo zakho egameni lakho.

UMboneleli akathengisi idatha yobuqu kwaye akayisebenziseli iinjongo zentengiso okanye zokuthengisa zamaqela esithathu.

6.1. Iindawo zokugcina idatha zeQonga kunye nekhowudi yesicelo zisingathwe kwiiseva ezikwiNgingqi yezoQoqosho yaseYurophu (EEA).

6.2. Abanye ababoneleli ngeenkonzo abachazwe kwiCandelo lesi-5 (umzekelo iStripe, iGoogle, iAnthropic, iOpenAI, iHeyGen, iElevenLabs, iFAL.ai, iBlotato) basekelwe eUnited States okanye kwamanye amazwe esithathu. Ukudluliselwa kwaba baboneleli kwenzeka ngokusekelwe kwisigqibo sokwanela seKhomishini yaseYurophu (kubandakanya i-EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, apho umboneleli eqinisekisiwe) okanye ngokusekelwe kwiiKlawusi zeSivumelwano eziQhelekileyo zeKhomishini yaseYurophu (Inqaku 46(2)(c) GDPR) kunye nemilinganiselo eyongezelelweyo apho kufuneka khona.

6.3. Ikopi yezokhuseleko ezifanelekileyo ingacelwa nge-imeyile yoqhagamshelwano echazwe kwiCandelo loku-1.

• Idatha yeakhawunti: ngexesha lobhaliso okanye umsebenzi weakhawunti. Emva kokucinywa kweakhawunti idatha iyacinywa, ngaphandle kolwazi ekufuneka lugcinwe ukuze kuthotyelwe umthetho werhafu kunye nowokubala (ukuya kuthi ga kwiminyaka emi-5).
  • Idatha yomxholo (imidiya, uhlalutyo, iividiyo ezivelisiweyo): de uzicime ngeQonga okanye uvale iakhawunti yakho.
  • Izitshixo zokudibanisa (BYOK): de uzisuse kuseto okanye uvale iakhawunti yakho; zigcinwe zifihliwe ngalo lonke ixesha.
  • Iilog zetekhnoloji: njengomgaqo, akukho ngaphezu kweenyanga ezili-12, ngaphandle kokuba kufuneka ixesha elide ukuphanda iziganeko zokhuseleko okanye ngokomthetho.
  • Iirekhodi zentlawulo: ngamaxesha afunekayo ngumthetho werhafu osebenzayo.

8.1. UMboneleli usebenzisa imilinganiselo yobugcisa kunye neyombutho ephucukileyo: ugqithiselo lwedatha olufihliweyo (HTTPS/TLS), ukufihla amagama ayimfihlo, ukufihla izitshixo ze-API ezigciniweyo, ukhuseleko lweseshoni olusekelwe kwi-JWT, ulawulo lokufikelela kunye nomgaqo wamalungelo amancinci.

8.2. Ukufikelela kwidatha yobuqu kulinganiselwe kubantu abayidingayo ukuze basebenzise iQonga kwaye ababotshelelwe yimigaqo yokugcina imfihlo.

8.3. Kwimeko yokophulwa kwedatha yobuqu enokuthi ibangele umngcipheko kumalungelo akho kunye nenkululeko, uMboneleli uya kwazisa igunya elilawulayo elifanelekileyo kwaye, apho kufunwa yiNqaku 34 GDPR, Abasebenzisi abachaphazelekayo.

Unelungelo loku:

  • cela ukufikelela kwidatha yakho yobuqu kwaye ufumane ikopi yayo;
  • cela ukulungiswa kwedatha enga正確anga okanye engafelelanga;
  • cela ukucinywa kwedatha (ilungelo lokulityalwa) apho kungekho sizathu somthetho sokugcinwa;
  • cela ukuthintelwa kokucubungula;
  • fumana idatha yakho kwifomathi ecwangcisiweyo, efundeka ngomatshini kwaye idluliselwe komnye umlawuli (ukudluliselwa kwedatha);
  • chasa ukucubungula okusekelwe kwizinto ezifanelekileyo, ngezizathu ezinxulumene nemeko yakho ethile;
  • rhoxisa imvume nangaliphi na ixesha, ngaphandle kokuchaphazela ukuba semthethweni kokucubungula okwenziwe phambi kokurhoxiswa.

Ukuze usebenzise la malungelo, thumela isicelo ku SEO@trendtraffic.pro. UMboneleli uphendula phakathi kwenyanga enye (inokwandiswa ngeenyanga ezimbini ezongezelelweyo kwizicelo ezintsonkothileyo, ngesaziso).

sections.h: 10. Ubukrelekrele bokwenziwa kunye noMmiselo (EU) 2024/1689 (Umthetho we-EU AI)
sections.b:
10.1. Le Qonga lihlanganisa iimodeli ze-AI ezikhoyo esidlangalaleni zababoneleli beqela lesithathu nge-API zabo ezisemthethweni (Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, FAL.ai) ukuze kuhlalutywe iintsingiselo, kuveliswe izikripthi namagama angundoqo, kugqithiselwe ulwimi, kuhlalutywe ividiyo ngesakhelo ngasinye, kuvezwe ii-avatar kunye nokwenziwa kwentetho. Umboneleli akazakhi okanye akaqeqeshi iimodeli zakhe ze-AI kwaye akangomboneleli weemodeli ze-AI ezisebenziseka ngokubanzi ngentsingiselo yoMmiselo (EU) 2024/1689 ("Umthetho we-EU AI").

10.2. Ukusetyenziswa kwe-AI yeQonga kungena kwiindidi zomngcipheko omncinci kunye nomngcipheko olinganiselweyo woMthetho we-EU AI. Le Qonga ayisebenzisi iinkqubo ze-AI ezinomngcipheko omkhulu ngentsingiselo yeSihlomelo III soMmiselo.

10.3. Ukucaca komxholo owenziweyo: Le Qonga sisixhobo sokwenza ividiyo, iaudio kunye nemifanekiso eyenziwe nge-AI kwaye elawulwe nge-AI (kubandakanya ii-avatar kunye namazwi akopishweyo). Iimpawu ze-AI zibhalwe ngokucacileyo kwi-interface. Apho ababoneleli be-AI abangaphantsi befaka iimpawu ezifundeka ngomatshini okanye ii-watermark kumxholo owenziweyo (Inqaku 50(2) loMthetho we-EU AI), le Qonga iyazigcina kwaye ayizisusi. Abasebenzisi babophelelekile ngokwesivumelwano ukuba babhengeze ii-deep fake kunye nomnye umxholo owenziweyo njengoko kufunwa yiNqaku 50(4) loMthetho we-EU AI kunye nemithetho yeenethiwekhi zentlalo apho bapapasha khona (bona Imigaqo yeNkonzo).

10.4. Izenzo ezithintelweyo yiNqaku 5 loMthetho we-EU AI — ukukhohlisa okungabonakaliyo, ukuxhaphaza ubungozi (kubandakanya obabantwana), ukufumana amanqaku entlalo, ukuvavanywa kwangaphambili kokwenza ulwaphulo-mthetho lwabantu, ukukhangela okungajoliswanga kwemifanekiso yobuso kwi-intanethi okanye kwi-CCTV, ukuqaphela iimvakalelo emsebenzini nasekufundeni, ukuhlelwa kwe-biometric ngokusekelwe kwiimpawu ezibuthathaka, kunye nokuchongwa kwe-biometric ekude ngexesha lokwenyani kwiindawo ezifikeleleka esidlangalaleni — azinikwa yiQonga, zithintelwe yiMigaqo yeNkonzo, kwaye izicelo ezijolise kwezo zenzo ziyaliwa.

10.5. Ukuqwalaselwa ngabantu: Iziphumo ze-AI (uhlalutyo, izikripthi, amagama angundoqo, iividiyo ezenziweyo) ziidrafti ezinokuba neempazamo. Abasebenzisi bahlola kwaye bavume umxholo phambi kokuba bawusebenzise okanye bawupapashe.

Le Qonga sisixhobo sobuchwephesha esenzelwe abantu abaneminyaka engama-18 ubuncinane. Umboneleli akaqokeleli ngabom idatha yobuqu yabantwana. Ukuba ukholelwa ukuba umntwana unike idatha yobuqu kwiQonga, nceda uqhagamshelane SEO@trendtraffic.pro kwaye idatha iya kucinywa.

Umboneleli unokulungisa lo Mgaqo-nkqubo, ngokukodwa ukubonisa utshintsho emthethweni okanye ekusebenzeni kweQonga. Inguqulelo yangoku isoloko ipapashwa kwiQonga, kunye nomhla "wokugqibela wokuhlaziywa" phezulu. Kwimeko yotshintsho olubalulekileyo, Abasebenzisi baya kwaziswa ngokongezelelekileyo nge-imeyile okanye kwisicelo.

4.3. Isilingo singakhanselwa nangaliphi na ixesha ngaphambi kokuba siphele, simahla, kuseto lwebhili.

4.4. Isilingo sasimahla sifumaneka kube kanye ngomsebenzisi. UMboneleli unokwala okanye abuyise izilingo kwimeko yokuxhaphaza (umz. ukubhalisa okuphindaphindiweyo).

5.1. Ukuqhubeka nokusebenzisa iQonga emva kwesilingo kufuna ubhaliso oluhlawulelwayo (umz. iPremium — €49 ngenyanga). Ixabiso langoku, kubandakanywa iirhafu ezisebenzayo, liboniswa kwiphepha lentlawulo ngexesha lentengiselwano.

5.2. Iintlawulo ziqhutywa ngumboneleli wentlawulo iStripe. UMboneleli akazigcini iinkcukacha zekhadi lentlawulo ezipheleleyo.

5.3. Ubhaliso luhlaziywa ngokuzenzekelayo kwiinyanga ezilandelelanayo de lukhanselwe. Ungakhansela nangaliphi na ixesha kuseto lwebhili; ukukhansela kusebenza ekupheleni kwexesha elihlawulelweyo langoku, kwaye uhlala unokufikelela de kube ngoko.

5.4. UMboneleli unokutshintsha amaxabiso obhaliso. Utshintsho lwamaxabiso lubhengezwe ubuncinane kwiintsuku ezili-14 ngaphambili kwaye lusebenza kuphela ukusukela kwixesha elilandelayo lokuhlawula; ukuba awuvumi, ungakhansela ngaphambi kokuba ixabiso elitsha lisebenze.

5.5. Iindleko zomntu wesithathu azifakwanga kubhaliso: iifizi zezitshixo ze-API zoMsebenzisi kunye nobhaliso (umz. iGoogle Gemini, iAnthropic Claude, iOpenAI, iFAL.ai, iElevenLabs, iHeyGen, iBlotato, iTikHub), iikhomishini zababoneleli bentlawulo kunye namaxabiso eenethiwekhi zentlalo zihlawulwa nguMsebenzisi ngokuthe ngqo kubaboneleli abafanelekileyo phantsi kwemigaqo yabo.

sections.h: 6. Umgaqo-nkqubo Wokungabuyisi Mali kunye neLungelo Lokurhoxisa
sections.b:
6.1. Le Qonga inikezela ngokufikelela ngokupheleleyo kumxholo wedijithali kunye nezixhobo zekhompyutha (kubandakanywa iindleko zokucubungula izicelo ze-AI) ngoko nangoko emva kwentlawulo ephumelelayo.

6.2. Abathengi kwi-EU — ukurhoxiswa kwelungelo lokurhoxisa: ngokuhambelana neSikhokelo 2011/83/EU kunye noMthetho wasePoland wama-30 kuMeyi 2014 malunga namaLungelo oMthengi (ingakumbi izibonelelo malunga nokubonelelwa komxholo wedijithali kunye neenkonzo zedijithali), ngokuvula ubhaliso oluhlawulelwayo umthengi ucela ngokucacileyo kwaye uyavuma ukuba ukusebenza kuqale ngoko nangoko, ngaphambi kokuphela kwexesha eliqhelekileyo lokurhoxisa leentsuku ezili-14, kwaye uyavuma ukuba ngaloo ndlela ulahlekelwa lilungelo lokurhoxisa ukusukela ngexesha inkonzo ifumaneka ngokupheleleyo. Olu vumelelwano kunye nokuqonda kuqokelelwa ngokongezelelekileyo xa uhlawula.

6.3. Ngokunjalo, iintlawulo zigqibelele kwaye azibuyiswa, kubandakanywa nalapho uMsebenzisi erhoxisa ubhaliso ngaphambi kokuphela kwexesha lokuhlawula (ukufikelela kuyaqhubeka de kube sekupheleni kwelo xesha). Isilingo sasimahla seentsuku ezisi-7 (Icandelo 4) sinikezelwa kanye ukuze inkonzo ikwazi ukuvavanywa ngokupheleleyo ngaphambi kokuba kwenziwe nayiphi na intlawulo.

6.4. Izibonelelo 6.1–6.3 azikhupheli ngaphandle okanye azinciphisi nawaphi na amalungelo anikezelwa ngumthetho onyanzelisayo kubathengi kwaye angenakushiywa, kubandakanywa izilungiso zomthetho zokungahambelani komxholo wedijithali kunye neenkonzo zedijithali (iSikhokelo (EU) 2019/770 kunye nokuphunyezwa kwayo ePoland). Apho ezi zibonelelo zinyanzelisayo zisebenza, zongamela eli Candelo.

6.5. Kubasebenzisi abangengabo abathengi (abasebenzisi beshishini), zonke iifizi zigqibelele kwaye azibuyiswa ukuya kuthi ga kumlinganiselo ovumelekileyo ngumthetho.

sections.h: 7. BYOK Integrations, Chrome Extension kunye ne-MCP
sections.b:
7.1. I-Platform ivumela uMsebenzisi ukuba adibanise ezakhe izitshixo ze-API kunye nezibhaliso zeenkonzo zomntu wesithathu ("BYOK") — umzekelo iGoogle Gemini, iAnthropic Claude, iOpenAI, iFAL.ai, iElevenLabs, iHeyGen, iBlotato okanye iTikHub. Ezi nkonzo zisetyenziswa phantsi kwezivumelwano zoMsebenzisi nababoneleli abafanelekileyo; uMsebenzisi uthwala iindleko ezihambelanayo kwaye unoxanduva lokuthobela imiqathango yabo baboneleli.

7.2. I-TrendTraffic Chrome extension idibanisa iimpawu ezithile (umz. iHeyGen, iGoogle Flow, iNotebookLM) nge akhawunti zakhe kunye nezibhaliso zoMsebenzisi kwisikhangeli sakhe. UMsebenzisi unoxanduva lokusebenzisa ezo akhawunti ngokuhambelana nemiqathango yeenkonzo ezifanelekileyo; uMboneleli akaqinisekisi ukuhambelana okungaphazamisekiyo kwe-extension kunye ne-interfaces zomntu wesithathu kwaye unokuhlaziya okanye ayeke izidibanisi ezithile ukuba umntu wesithathu utshintsha imithetho okanye iteknoloji yakhe.

7.3. Izitshixo ze-API ezibonelelwe nguMsebenzisi zigcinwa zifihliwe kwaye zisetyenziswa kuphela ukwenza imisebenzi eceliwe nguMsebenzisi. UMsebenzisi unokuzicima nangaliphi na ixesha kwiisetingi.

7.4. Isitshixo se-MCP somntu sivumela abancedisi be-AI (umz. iClaude) ukuba bafikelele kwiakhawunti yoMsebenzisi. UMsebenzisi unoxanduva lokugcina isitshixo siyimfihlo kunye nazo zonke izenzo ezenziwe ngaso, kwaye unokuyirhoxisa nangaliphi na ixesha.

8.1. UMsebenzisi uzibophelele ukuba angasebenzisi i-Platform ngenxa yezi zinto zilandelayo:

  • nawuphi na umsebenzi ongekho mthethweni, ispam, ubuqhetseba okanye naluphi na uhlobo lobuqhetseba;
  • ukudala, ukuhlalutya okanye ukusasaza umxholo ongekho mthethweni, ohlaselayo, okhathazayo, okanye ophula amalungelo empahla yengqondo, ubumfihlo okanye amalungelo okusasaza abantu besithathu;
  • ukudala okanye ukusebenzisa umfanekiso okanye ilizwi lomntu wokwenyani ngaphandle kwamalungelo afanelekileyo okanye imvume yalo mntu, kubandakanya ukuzenza abantu bokwenyani;
  • ukudala umxholo wesini, osenyongweni okanye ohlaselayo obonisa abantu bokwenyani abachongekayo ngaphandle kwemvume yabo ecacileyo, okanye nawuphi na umxholo onjalo obandakanya abantwana abancinci (okungavumelekanga ngokungqongqo kwaye kuya kuxelwa kwabasemagunyeni abafanelekileyo);
  • ukudala umxholo okhohlisayo ojoliswe ekulahlekeni koluntu, kubandakanya ulwazi olungachanekanga malunga nonyulo, impilo yoluntu okanye ukhuseleko;
  • ukuphula imiqathango yenkonzo yabantu besithathu abahlanganisiweyo (ingakumbi iTikTok, iMeta/Instagram, iYouTube/Google, iHeyGen, iElevenLabs, iBlotato, iStripe), kubandakanya imithetho yabo malunga nemidiya eyenziweyo kunye nokupapashwa okuzenzekelayo;
  • ukuzama ukuphazamisa, ukugcwala, ukuguqula ubunjineli okanye ukufumana ukufikelela okungagunyaziswanga kwi-Platform;
  • ukusebenzisa iimpawu ze-AI ngokuchasene neNqaku lesi-5 loMmiselo (EU) 2024/1689 (EU AI Act), kubandakanya: ukukhohlisa okungabonakaliyo; ukuxhaphaza ubuthathaka babantwana okanye amaqela asengozini; ukufumana amanqaku oluntu; ukuvavanya kwangaphambili ulwaphulo-mthetho lwabantu; ukukrwela okungajoliswanga kwemifanekiso yobuso kwi-intanethi okanye kwi-CCTV; ukuqaphela iimvakalelo zabasebenzi okanye abafundi; ukuhlela ngokwebhayometri ngokusekelwe kwiimpawu ezibuthathaka; okanye ukuchonga ngokwebhayometri okukude ngexesha lokwenyani kwiindawo ezifikeleleka esidlangalaleni.

8.2. Ngokulayisha ifoto okanye irekhodi yelizwi, uMsebenzisi ubonisa kwaye uqinisekisa ukuba ngumntu obonisiweyo/orekhodiweyo okanye unayo imvume ecacileyo, enolwazi yalo mntu (kwaye, kwizinto eziphantsi kwe-copyright, iilayisensi ezifanelekileyo).

8.3. Kwimeko yokuphulwa, uMboneleli unokususa umxholo ophulayo kwaye amise okanye aphelise iakhawunti yoMsebenzisi ngaphandle kokubuyiselwa kwemali (Icandelo le-13), ngaphandle kokuchaphazela ezinye izilungiso zomthetho.

sections.h: 9. Iimpawu ze-AI, Umxholo oYenziweyo kunye nokuNgqongqo
sections.b:
9.1. Iimpawu ze-AI ze-Platform zisebenza kwiimodeli ezikhoyo esidlangalaleni zeenjongo ezibanzi zababoneleli bomntu wesithathu (iGoogle Gemini, iAnthropic Claude, iOpenAI, iHeyGen, iElevenLabs, iFAL.ai) ezibizwa nge-API esemthethweni. Iinkcukacha zokucutshungulwa kwedatha zibekwe kwi Privacy Policy.

9.2. Umxholo owenziwe yi-AI (uhlahlubo, izikripthi, amagama angundoqo, i-voiceovers, iividiyo) unokuqulatha iimpazamo okanye ukungachaneki kwaye awubandakanyi iingcebiso zobuchwephesha, zomthetho, zonyango okanye zemali. UMsebenzisi kufuneka ahlolisise umxholo owenziweyo phambi kokuba awusebenzise okanye awupapashe kwaye uthwala uxanduva olupheleleyo lokusetyenziswa kwawo.

9.3. Ukuveza umxholo owenziweyo: apho uMsebenzisi enza okanye alawule umfanekiso, iaudio okanye umxholo wevidiyo ofana kakhulu nabantu abakhoyo, izinto, iindawo okanye iziganeko kwaye unokubonakala ngobuxoki kumntu njengowokwenyani okanye oyinyani ("i-deep fake"), uMsebenzisi kufuneka aveze ngokucacileyo nangokwahlukileyo ukuba umxholo wenziwe okanye walawulwa ngokwenziweyo, ngokuhambelana neNqaku lama-50(4) le-EU AI Act kunye nemithetho yeenethiwekhi zentlalo apho umxholo upapashwa khona. Apho ababoneleli be-AI bomntu wesithathu bafaka iimpawu ezifundeka ngomatshini okanye ii-watermark kumxholo owenziweyo, uMsebenzisi akufuneki azisuse okanye azifihle.

9.4. UMboneleli akaqinisekisi ukuba umxholo owenziwe yi-AI awunazo izilungelo zomntu wesithathu (umz. apho igalelo loMsebenzisi liqulathe izinto ezikhuselweyo) kwaye akaqinisekisi nawuphi na umphumo othile wezorhwebo (ukubukwa, ukufikelela, ukwenza imali).

10.1. Umsebenzisi ugcina onke amalungelo kwizinto azilayishayo. Umsebenzisi unika uMboneleli ilayisenisi engakhethekanga, yehlabathi lonke yokubamba, ukugcina, ukucubungula, ukulungelelanisa kunye nokuhambisa ezo zinto kuphela ukuya kuthi ga apho kufuneka khona ukubonelela ngeenkonzo zeQonga (kubandakanya ukuhambisa kubaboneleli be-AI kunye neenethiwekhi zentlalo ezikhethwe ngumsebenzisi). Ilayisenisi iphela xa umxholo okanye iakhawunti icinyiwe, ngaphandle kweekopi ezifunwa ngumthetho.

10.2. Phakathi koMboneleli noMsebenzisi, uMboneleli akabangi malungelo kwiziphumo eziveliselwe uMsebenzisi. Amalungelo oMsebenzisi kwiziphumo eziveliswe yi-AI amiselwa ngumthetho osebenzayo kunye nemigaqo yababoneleli be-AI ababandakanyekayo; uMsebenzisi unoxanduva lokuqinisekisa ukuba ukusetyenziswa kwakhe okucetyiweyo kuvumelekile.

10.3. Isoftware yeQonga, uyilo, iimpawu zorhwebo kunye neenkcukacha-manani zihlala ziyipropati yoMboneleli okanye abanini-layisenisi bakhe. Le Migqaliselo ayiniki malungelo kubo ngaphandle kwelungelo lokusebenzisa iQonga njengoko kucetyiwe.

10.4. Umxholo womntu wesithathu oboniswe kuhlazo lweendlela (iividiyo, izigqubuthelo, iimetriki zeTikTok/Instagram/YouTube) uhlala uyipropati yabanini-malungelo kunye namaqonga afanelekileyo; uboniswa kuhlazo lwentengiso. Nakuphi na ukusetyenziswa okungaphezulu komxholo onjalo ngumsebenzisi (umz. ukulayisha kwakhona ividiyo yomnye umntu) kufuna isiseko somthetho somsebenzisi.

11.1. Ukucubungula idatha yobuqu yabasebenzisi kuchazwe kwi-Polisi yaBucala.

11.2. Apho izinto ezilayishwa okanye ezicubungulwa ngumsebenzisi kwiQonga zineenkcukacha zobuqu zabantu besithathu (umzekelo, umfanekiso okanye ilizwi lomthengisi, uphononongo lwabathengi), umsebenzisi usebenza njengoMlawuli weDatha yale datha kwaye uMboneleli uyicubungula njengoMcubunguli ngaphakathi kwentsingiselo yeNqaku lama-28 le-GDPR — ngokukhethekileyo kwimiyalelo ebhaliweyo yoMsebenzisi eboniswa ngokusetyenziswa kweempawu zeQonga, kwaye kuphela ukubonelela ngenkonzo.

11.3. UMboneleli usebenzisa imilinganiselo yokhuseleko efanelekileyo yobugcisa kunye neyombutho, usebenzisa kuphela abacubunguli abancinci abadweliswe kwi-Polisi yaBucala (uMsebenzisi uyavuma ukuba baqeshwe; utshintsho olubalulekileyo luya kubhengezwa), unceda uMsebenzisi ngaphakathi kwesizathu ngezicelo zomxholo wedatha, kwaye ucima okanye ubuyisela idatha ekupheleni kwenkonzo ngokuhambelana nemigaqo yokugcina yePolisi yaBucala.

12.1. "Njengoko injalo": iQonga libonelelwa "njengoko linjalo" kwaye "njengoko lifumaneka". Ukuya kuthi ga apho kuvumelekileyo ngumthetho, uMboneleli akaqinisekisi ukuba iQonga liya kusebenza ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka okanye iimpazamo okanye ukuba liya kuhlangabezana nolindelo oluthile loMsebenzisi.

12.2. Ukuxhomekeka komntu wesithathu: ukusebenza kweQonga kuxhomekeke kakhulu kubaboneleli bomntu wesithathu. UMboneleli akanaxanduva loku: ukuphazamiseka, utshintsho lwemigaqo okanye imida yee-API kunye neenkonzo zeTikTok, Meta/Instagram, YouTube/Google, TikHub, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Google (Gemini, Flow, NotebookLM), Anthropic, OpenAI, FAL.ai, Blotato okanye Stripe; ngezicelo zokulawula zeenethiwekhi zentlalo malunga nomxholo opapashwe ngumsebenzisi; okanye ngezinto ezibangelwa ngababoneleli bokubamba.

12.3. Ukuya kuthi ga apho kuvumelekileyo ngumthetho, uMboneleli akanaxanduva lomonakalo ongafanelekanga, inzuzo elahlekileyo, ukulahleka kwedatha okanye ukulahleka kwabathengi okuvela ekusebenziseni, okanye ukungakwazi ukusebenzisa, iQonga.

12.4. Uxanduva olukhulu loMboneleli oludibeneyo kumsebenzisi kuzo zonke izicelo luthintelwe kwisixa esihlawulwe ngokwenene ngumsebenzisi ngeenkonzo zeQonga kwinyanga yokugqibela yekhalenda ngaphambi kwesiganeko esibangela isicelo.

12.5. Izithintelo kweli Candelo azisebenzi kuxanduva lokuziphatha ngabom okanye ukungakhathali okukhulu, ukufa okanye ukwenzakala komntu, okanye nakwezinye iimeko apho uxanduva lungakwazi ukuthintelwa phantsi komthetho onyanzelisayo. Kubathengi, amayeza asemthethweni okungahambelani kweenkonzo zedijithali ahlala engachaphazeleki (Icandelo 6.4).

13.1. Umsebenzisi unokuyeka ukusebenzisa iQonga kwaye acime iakhawunti nangaliphi na ixesha; Icandelo lesi-6 lisebenza kwiintlawulo esele zenziwe.

13.2. UMboneleli unokumisa okanye anqamule iakhawunti, asuse umxholo kwaye enqabe inkonzo — ngaphandle kokubuyiselwa kwezixa esele zihlawulwe — kwimeko yokwaphulwa okubalulekileyo kwale Migqaliselo (ingakumbi iCandelo lesi-8), apho kufunwa ngumthetho okanye ngomyalelo wegosa elinegunya, okanye kwimeko yesoyikiso esikhulu sokhuseleko. Apho kufanelekileyo, uMboneleli uya kuqala ukukhupha isilumkiso kwaye abeke umda wokulungisa ukwaphulwa; kwimeko yabathengi, amalungelo asemthethweni malunga namaxesha ahlawulweyo ahlala engachaphazeleki apho ukunqanyulwa kungabangelwa kukwaphulwa komthengi.

13.3. Amacandelo 6, 10, 12 kunye ne-15 ahlala esebenza emva kokunqanyulwa.

14.1. UMboneleli unokuyilungisa le Migqaliselo ngezizathu ezifanelekileyo: utshintsho kumthetho, iimpawu ezintsha, iimfuno zokhuseleko okanye utshintsho kwiinkonzo zomntu wesithathu ezidibeneyo.

14.2. Abasebenzisi baya kwaziswa ngezilungiso ezibalulekileyo ubuncinane kwiintsuku ezili-14 ngaphambi kokuba zisebenze, nge-imeyile okanye kwisicelo. Ukuba uMsebenzisi akavumi, unokunqamula umrhumo ngaphambi kokuba izilungiso zisebenze; ukuqhubeka kokusetyenziswa emva kwaloo mhla kubonisa ukwamkelwa.

15.1. Le Migqaliselo ilawulwa yimithetho yeRiphabhlikhi yasePoland. Ukuba uMsebenzisi ungumthengi, olu khetho lomthetho alumbandezeli kukhuseleko olunikezelwa yimigaqo enyanzelekileyo yomthetho wendawo yakhe yokuhlala rhoqo (Inqaku 6(2) loMmiselo (EC) No 593/2008, "Rome I").

15.2. Kubasebenzisi beshishini, iingxabano zixhomekeke kulawulo olukhethekileyo lwenkundla efanelekileyo yendawo ebhalisiweyo yoMboneleli (Warsaw, Poland). Kubathengi, ulawulo lumiselwa yimithetho esebenzayo esemthethweni.

15.3. Umthengi unokusebenzisa iindlela zokukhalaza nokulungisa ngaphandle kwenkundla, umzekelo uncedo lwePolish Trade Inspection (Inspekcja Handlowa), i-ombudsmen yabathengi kamasipala okanye yesithili, okanye izinto ze-ADR zelizwe labo. (Iqonga le-EU lokusombulula iingxabano kwi-intanethi layekiswa ngoJulayi 2025.)

15.4. Izikhalazo zingathunyelwa ku SEO@trendtraffic.pro; uMboneleli uphendula phakathi kweentsuku ezili-14.

cookies.title: Umgaqo-nkqubo weeKuki
cookies.subtitle: weqonga leTrendTraffic
cookies.metaDescription: Zeziphi iikuki kunye neengxelo zeLocal Storage ezisetyenziswa yiTrendTraffic, zeziphi iinjongo kunye nexesha elingakanani, zeziphi iinkampani zangaphandle ezibeka iikuki (Stripe, Google sign-in), kunye nendlela yokunika, ukwala okanye ukutshintsha imvume yakho.

sections.b:
1.1. Iikuki ziifayile ezincinci zombhalo ezigcinwe kwisixhobo sakho xa undwendwela iwebhusayithi, ezivumela isiza ukuba siqaphele isixhobo sakho kwaye sikhumbule izinto ozikhethayo.

1.2. Ukongeza kwiikuki, iqonga leTrendTraffic lisebenzisa i-Local Storage yesikhangeli — phakathi kwezinye izinto, ukugcina ithokheni yogunyaziso yeseshoni yakho, ulwimi lwakho kunye nomxholo wonxibelelwano, kunye nokhetho lwakho lwemvume yekuki. Lo Mgaqo-nkqubo usebenza kwiikuki kunye neLocal Storage ngokufanayo.

2.1. Eziyimfuneko ngokungqongqo (ezobuchwepheshe) — ziyafuneka ukuze iQonga lisebenze; zisetyenziswa ngokusekelwe kumdla osemthethweni woMboneleli kwaye azifuni mvume:

  • vibevox_token — ithokheni yogunyaziso ye-JWT yeseshoni yakho (Local Storage; de uphume okanye ithokheni iphelelwe lixesha);
  • vibevox_user — i-cache yeprofayile yomsebenzisi ongenileyo (Local Storage; de uphume);
  • tt_cookie_consent — igcina ukhetho lwakho lwemvume yekuki (Local Storage; de ulutshintshe okanye ulucime).

2.2. Ezisebenzayo (izinto ezikhethwayo):

  • i18nextLng — ulwimi olukhethiweyo lonxibelelwano (Local Storage; de lutshintshwe okanye lucinywe);
  • vibevox_theme — umxholo okhanyayo/omnyama (Local Storage; de lutshintshwe okanye lucinywe).

Ngenxa yezizathu zembali, ezinye izichongi zineprefikisi "vibevox" yomgca wemveliso yangaphambili yoMboneleli; zezelona qonga leTrendTraffic.

2.3. Uhlalutyo: iQonga okwangoku alibeki naziphi na iikuki zohlalutyo okanye zokukhangela zentengiso zomntu wesithathu. Iimetriki zenkonzo ezisisiseko, ezikhusela ubumfihlo ziqokelelwa kwicala leseva ngaphandle kokulandelela kwiindawo ezahlukeneyo. Ukuba uhlalutyo olusekelwe kwimvume luyakhe lwaziswa, luya kusebenza kuphela emva kokuba ukhethe "Yamkela zonke".

2.4. Iikuki zomntu wesithathu: iinkonzo zangaphandle ezidibaniswe kwiQonga zingabeka iikuki zazo xa uzisebenzisa:

  • Stripe — ukhuseleko lwentlawulo kunye nokuthintela ubuqhetseba kumaphepha entlawulo nawokuhlawula (umz. __stripe_mid, ~1 unyaka; __stripe_sid, ~30 imizuzu);
  • Google — xa usebenzisa "Ngena ngeGoogle", iGoogle ibeka iikuki phantsi komgaqo-nkqubo wayo;
  • Iinethiwekhi zentlalo ezixhunyiwe (TikTok, Meta/Instagram, YouTube) — kuphela ngaphakathi konxibelelwano lwazo xa uzixhuma okanye uzivula.

• Ukuqinisekiswa kunye nokukhuselwa kweseshoni yoMsebenzisi.
  • Ukhuseleko lweentengiselwano zentlawulo.
  • Ukukhumbula ulwimi, umxholo kunye nokhetho lwakho lwemvume.
